description: We are a team of creative and motivated students from Bahrain participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026! Our goal is to use NASA's Earth science data to analyze environmental changes, especially extreme heat and climate change. We bring skills in research, design, creativity, and problem-solving. We're looking for members skilled in coding, data analysis, Earth science, and UI/UX design. Join us to create an innovative solution with a positive local impact!
